pageSize.description: Number of records to show per page.

pageSizes.description: The list of page size options displayed in the page size dropdown.

buttonCount.description: Sets the maximum numeric buttons count before the buttons are collapsed.

info.description: Toggles the information about the current page and the total number of records.

pageType.description: Accepts the `numeric` (buttons with numbers) and `input` (input for typing the page number) values.

previousNext.description: Toggles the Previous and Next buttons.
